author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Philosophy and Public Affairs, a prestige philosophy journal, bans paper submissions using AI, they are so wrong.

If AI invented a cancer drugs, you would not ban it simply because AI made it. A philosophy paper is all about its intellectual content, it doesn't matter who wrote the paper. The author is a human, AI, a dog or an alien, shouldn't affect the value of the paper.

One day, AI will be better philosopher than humans.

shared_article.title: PPA changed its mind and now prohibits AI papers. Terrible move.
